computer-vision: A dynamic split-view illustration depicting a bustling urban street from the first-person perspective of an autonomous vehicle's sensor system, seamlessly transitioning from raw visual input into multi-layered machine perception. edge-ai: A detailed cutaway conceptual illustration centered on a sleek, battery-powered drone hovering in a remote, offline landscape with a subtle "no network connection" icon displayed near its interface. A transparent cross-section of the drone exposes a compact, ultra-low-power microchip glowing with an active neural network lattice, instantly translating real-time camera sensor data into flight decisions on the spot. Flanking the drone are a smartphone and a compact security camera, both highlighted with identical internal AI chips performing on-device processing.
